fix.shows: Frontline reports a preliminary analysis that the Sabar Institute shared with it, of the names left off Telangana's draft roll in the 104 Assembly seats outside Hyderabad. Sabar compiled the Election Commission's booth-wise lists of absent, shifted, dead and duplicate electors and counted 53,96,806 names against the Commission's 53,97,791, and its total matched the Commission's in 31 of 32 districts. By its count about 50.2 per cent of the names are women's, and more women than men were left off in 91 of the 104 seats. It describes about 71 per cent of those women as married, with an average age of about 45. The roll has no column for marital status, and the article does not say how Sabar worked it out. It counts 1,152 third gender electors among the names left off, and Frontline gives 2,350 on Telangana's 2023 roll. It puts 85.8 per cent of the names, 46.31 lakh, as marked shifted, untraceable or already enrolled elsewhere. The roll has no column for religion either, and Sabar classifies the names by religion itself, counting a name as Muslim only where both the Telugu and the English spelling on the roll point to it. By that classification Muslim names are 12.5 per cent of the names left off, in districts where the 2011 Census puts Muslims at 8.8 per cent. In the seven seats the BJP won in 2023 they are, by the same classification, nearly 45 per cent of the names marked untraceable and 17 per cent of those marked dead. Sabar's lead researcher, Sabir Ahamed, tells Frontline that these figures show an association with religion, gender and other characteristics and cannot show that any of them caused a name to be left off. Sabar also finds 202 booths where more than 90 per cent of the names left off are Muslim names by its classification, and Sabir Ahamed says such a booth partly reflects who lives on that street and that only a check of the addresses on the ground can show why so many were marked untraceable. Of 532 booths it examined for the reasons recorded, it finds 512 where more than 95 per cent of the names left off carry the same reason, permanently shifted.
